// diagnostic

E0301

`impl` for unknown type

What

`impl` for unknown type

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0301

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0301: tests/ui/external_method_unknown_type.stderr.

Error [E0068]: this callable uses the retired result-arrow shape.
  --> tests/ui/external_method_unknown_type.jet:1:20
    |
  1 | fn Missing.build() -> Missing :: Missing.build()
    |                    ^^
 Why: a return type sits after the parameter list, and `->` introduces the body; an effect ceiling follows the return type
 Fix: write `fn name(...) Type -> body`, or `fn name(...) Type -[Effects]> { … }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0068

Error [E0065]: this function uses the retired `::` body marker.
  --> tests/ui/external_method_unknown_type.jet:1:31
    |
  1 | fn Missing.build() -> Missing :: Missing.build()
    |                               ^^
 Why: A one-expression function body uses `->`; `::` binds a name, and `=` fills a slot inside a definition.
 Fix: replace `::` with `->`; `jet fmt` applies this fix.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0065

Error [E0301]: `impl Missing` names a type that doesn't exist
  --> tests/ui/external_method_unknown_type.jet:1:4
    |
  1 | fn Missing.build() -> Missing :: Missing.build()
    |    ^^^^^^^
 Why: `Missing` hasn't been defined as a struct or enum
 Fix: define `struct Missing` or `enum Missing` first
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0301

Error [E0119]: there's no type called `Missing`
  --> tests/ui/external_method_unknown_type.jet:1:23
    |
  1 | fn Missing.build() -> Missing :: Missing.build()
    |                       ^^^^^^^
 Why: the types are `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, and `String` (plus types you define)
 Fix: check the spelling, or define the struct or enum first
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0119

Error [E0107]: nothing named `Missing` exists here
  --> tests/ui/external_method_unknown_type.jet:1:34
    |
  1 | fn Missing.build() -> Missing :: Missing.build()
    |                                  ^^^^^^^
 Why: a name must be declared before it's used
 Fix: declare it first: `Missing :: ...`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0107
